2026年7月2-3日，课题组受邀参加在上海富悦大酒店举行的2026人工智能与生物医药生态大会（AIBC2026）。作为国内“AI+生物医药”领域规模最大、连续举办时间最长的标杆性行业峰会，本届大会汇集了超过1500位来自顶尖科研机构、全球制药巨头、AI技术公司与投资机构的专家与决策者。

2026年6月25-26日，课题组组长段斌研究员受邀赴重庆参加第二届西部单细胞组学技术应用论坛暨空间组学前沿论坛，并在数据科学与算法突破板块发表了题为 “空间组学的可解释表征与临床转化” 的主题报告。
在报告中，段斌研究员系统介绍了课题组在可解释人工智能与空间组学交叉领域的最新研究进展。报告聚焦于如何通过创新的机器学习算法，对高维空间转录组数据进行可解释的表征学习。该研究为理解复杂疾病的分子机制提供了新的计算视角，并为空间组学数据向临床 biomarkers 发现与转化应用搭建了桥梁。报告内容引发了来自高校、医院及产业界同行的广泛关注与热烈讨论。

content: SpaPheno is an open-source interpretable machine learning R package explicitly designed to bridge spatial transcriptomic profiles and clinical phenotypes, advancing spatially informed precision oncology research. Built upon the core framework proposed in the benchmark study, this package enables systematic integration of high-resolution spatial transcriptomics data with clinically annotated bulk RNA-seq data, empowering researchers to mine spatially resolved biomarkers that are predictive of critical patient outcomes including survival, tumor staging, and immunotherapy response.
summary: SpaPheno is an open-source interpretable machine learning R package explicitly designed to bridge spatial transcriptomic profiles and clinical phenotypes, advancing spatially informed precision oncology research. Built upon the core framework proposed in the benchmark study, this package enables systematic integration of high-resolution spatial transcriptomics data with clinically annotated bulk RNA-seq data, empowering researchers to mine spatially resolved biomarkers that are predictive of critical patient outcomes including survival, tumor staging, and immunotherapy response.
title: SpaPheno

summary: In conclusion, SpaPheno demonstrates that interpretable machine learning, grounded in spatial principles of tissue organization, can systematically reveal where and why clinical phenotypes arise within complex tumor ecosystems. By integrating spatial embeddings, cell-type composition, and phenotype-informed attribution, SpaPheno moves beyond descriptive or black-box models, establishing a rigorous framework for mechanistic spatial inference. This approach is broadly applicable across diseases and data modalities, offering a scalable path toward spatially informed biomarker discovery and artificial intelligence assisted precision medicine.
title: SpaPheno: Linking Spatial Transcriptomics to Clinical Phenotypes with Interpretable Machine Learning
